sequence.name: trade-level attribution
sequence.interpretation: Direct realized P&L is right-tail concentrated. MU alone contributed about 38.8% of net P&L, while the top five winning lots supplied about 42.7% of all positive P&L.

sequence.name: best-trades removal stress
sequence.methodCaveat: Fixed-path hindsight excision: removed winning lots are replaced by 0% returns while all other historical trade paths remain fixed. This is a stress test, not a causal/tradable counterfactual.
sequence.interpretation: Historical compound growth materially depends on a small set of large winners, which is structurally consistent with momentum but makes 55% CAGR a fragile point estimate.

sequence.name: entry/exit timing stress
sequence.methodCaveat: Daily-OHLC fixed-path repricing only. The same historical symbols, signal/risk path and reasons are held fixed while entry and exit opens are shifted. Full-history +15m/+30m/VWAP data was unavailable, so no intraday result is fabricated.
sequence.interpretation: Exact next-session-open execution is a material robustness concern. A full causal state-machine delayed-execution audit should precede any Production rule change.

sequence.name: universe perturbation Monte Carlo
sequence.methodCaveat: 50 paths per scenario. Each point-in-time stored Top80 loses random members; there is no replacement from outside Top80 because universe-history stores only Top80. This tests missing/misclassified candidates, not true Top80 boundary noise.
sequence.interpretation: The strategy generally survives moderate Universe omissions, but CAGR is sensitive to which candidates are missing. Five-percent omission is reasonably resilient; ten-percent omission creates materially wider downside dispersion.

sequence.name: parameter neighborhood
sequence.methodCaveat: One-factor-at-a-time in-sample neighborhood audit, not optimization. QQQ 10M MA was audited separately.
sequence.interpretation: Most Production values are not isolated local maxima: nearby momentum weights and some stop/circuit alternatives are comparable or better in-sample. Recovery confirmation=10 is different: both 8 and 12 days are materially worse, so this parameter deserves specific overfit/OOS scrutiny rather than optimization toward the historical winner.

strengths: N-PORT delay up to 3 sessions was previously robust.
QQQ 10M Gate was previously robust across nearby MA windows and rolling periods.
Moderate random Universe omissions generally preserve a high-CAGR strategy.
materialConcerns: Material sensitivity to exact next-session-open execution in fixed-path timing stress.
Technology/growth-factor concentration found in prior leave-one-out audit.
Recovery confirmation=10 behaves like a local in-sample peak relative to 8 and 12 days.
overallAssessment.productionDecision: No Production change from these tests alone. The most important next audit is a full state-machine delayed-execution simulation (+1 session), followed by OOS/walk-forward scrutiny of recovery confirmation days.
